<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#logicalop_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Logical<wbr>Op</a>
</span>

        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Logical operator of configuration mode, and/or.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="name_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#name_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="optionsarr_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#optionsarr_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Options<wbr>Arr</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd><p>CC matching conditions JSON serialized string. Example: [{&quot;key&quot;:&quot;Method&quot;,&quot;args&quot;:[&quot;=R0VU&quot;],&quot;match&quot;:&quot;0&quot;,&quot;encodeflag&quot;:true}].</p>
<p>Supported key types: URL, Method, Post, Referer, Cookie, User-Agent, CustomHeader, IPLocation, CaptchaRisk, CaptchaDeviceRisk, CaptchaScore.</p>
<p>Match operators by key type:</p>
<ul>
<li>When Key is URL: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 1 (prefix), 6 (suffix), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains)</li>
<li>When Key is Method: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal)</li>
<li>When Key is Post: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains)</li>
<li>When Key is Cookie: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains)</li>
<li>When Key is Referer: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 1 (prefix), 6 (suffix), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists), 4 (empty)</li>
<li>When Key is User-Agent: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 1 (prefix), 6 (suffix), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists), 4 (empty)</li>
<li>When Key is CustomHeader: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains), 4 (empty), 5 (not exists)</li>
<li>When Key is IPLocation: 13 (belongs to), 14 (not belongs to)</li>
<li>When Key is CaptchaRisk: 15 (numerically equal), 16 (numerically not equal), 13 (belongs to), 14 (not belongs to), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists)</li>
<li>When Key is CaptchaDeviceRisk: 13 (belongs to), 14 (not belongs to), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists)</li>
<li>When Key is CaptchaScore: 15 (numerically equal), 17 (numerically greater than), 18 (numerically less than), 19 (numerically greater than or equal), 20 (numerically less than or equal), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists)</li>
</ul>
<p>Encoding rules: The args parameter requires encodeflag to be set to true. For Post, Cookie, or CustomHeader keys, Base64 encode both parameter name and value (remove trailing =), then concatenate with = sign (e.g., Base64(name)=Base64(value)). For Referer or User-Agent keys, Base64 encode the value (remove trailing =) and prefix with = sign (e.g., =Base64(value)).</p>
</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="sessionapplieds_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#sessionapplieds_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Session<wbr>Applieds</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">List&lt;int&gt;</span>

</span>

        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd><p>CC matching conditions JSON serialized string. Example: [{&quot;key&quot;:&quot;Method&quot;,&quot;args&quot;:[&quot;=R0VU&quot;],&quot;match&quot;:&quot;0&quot;,&quot;encodeflag&quot;:true}].</p>
<p>Supported key types: URL, Method, Post, Referer, Cookie, User-Agent, CustomHeader, IPLocation, CaptchaRisk, CaptchaDeviceRisk, CaptchaScore.</p>
<p>Match operators by key type:</p>
<ul>
<li>When Key is URL: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 1 (prefix), 6 (suffix), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains)</li>
<li>When Key is Method: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal)</li>
<li>When Key is Post: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains)</li>
<li>When Key is Cookie: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains)</li>
<li>When Key is Referer: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 1 (prefix), 6 (suffix), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists), 4 (empty)</li>
<li>When Key is User-Agent: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 1 (prefix), 6 (suffix), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists), 4 (empty)</li>
<li>When Key is CustomHeader: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains), 4 (empty), 5 (not exists)</li>
<li>When Key is IPLocation: 13 (belongs to), 14 (not belongs to)</li>
<li>When Key is CaptchaRisk: 15 (numerically equal), 16 (numerically not equal), 13 (belongs to), 14 (not belongs to), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists)</li>
<li>When Key is CaptchaDeviceRisk: 13 (belongs to), 14 (not belongs to), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists)</li>
<li>When Key is CaptchaScore: 15 (numerically equal), 17 (numerically greater than), 18 (numerically less than), 19 (numerically greater than or equal), 20 (numerically less than or equal), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists)</li>
</ul>
<p>Encoding rules: The args parameter requires encodeflag to be set to true. For Post, Cookie, or CustomHeader keys, Base64 encode both parameter name and value (remove trailing =), then concatenate with = sign (e.g., Base64(name)=Base64(value)). For Referer or User-Agent keys, Base64 encode the value (remove trailing =) and prefix with = sign (e.g., =Base64(value)).</p>
</dd><dt class="property-optional"

        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd><p>CC matching conditions JSON serialized string. Example: [{&quot;key&quot;:&quot;Method&quot;,&quot;args&quot;:[&quot;=R0VU&quot;],&quot;match&quot;:&quot;0&quot;,&quot;encodeflag&quot;:true}].</p>
<p>Supported key types: URL, Method, Post, Referer, Cookie, User-Agent, CustomHeader, IPLocation, CaptchaRisk, CaptchaDeviceRisk, CaptchaScore.</p>
<p>Match operators by key type:</p>
<ul>
<li>When Key is URL: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 1 (prefix), 6 (suffix), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains)</li>
<li>When Key is Method: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal)</li>
<li>When Key is Post: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains)</li>
<li>When Key is Cookie: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains)</li>
<li>When Key is Referer: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 1 (prefix), 6 (suffix), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists), 4 (empty)</li>
<li>When Key is User-Agent: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 1 (prefix), 6 (suffix), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists), 4 (empty)</li>
<li>When Key is CustomHeader: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains), 4 (empty), 5 (not exists)</li>
<li>When Key is IPLocation: 13 (belongs to), 14 (not belongs to)</li>
<li>When Key is CaptchaRisk: 15 (numerically equal), 16 (numerically not equal), 13 (belongs to), 14 (not belongs to), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists)</li>
<li>When Key is CaptchaDeviceRisk: 13 (belongs to), 14 (not belongs to), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists)</li>
<li>When Key is CaptchaScore: 15 (numerically equal), 17 (numerically greater than), 18 (numerically less than), 19 (numerically greater than or equal), 20 (numerically less than or equal), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists)</li>
</ul>
<p>Encoding rules: The args parameter requires encodeflag to be set to true. For Post, Cookie, or CustomHeader keys, Base64 encode both parameter name and value (remove trailing =), then concatenate with = sign (e.g., Base64(name)=Base64(value)). For Referer or User-Agent keys, Base64 encode the value (remove trailing =) and prefix with = sign (e.g., =Base64(value)).</p>
</dd><dt class="property-optional"

        <span class="property-type">int</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Match method, 0(equal), 1(prefix), 2(contains), 3(not equal), 6(suffix), 7(not contains).</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_name_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_name_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Name</a>

        <span id="state_optionsarr_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_optionsarr_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Options<wbr>Arr</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd><p>CC matching conditions JSON serialized string. Example: [{&quot;key&quot;:&quot;Method&quot;,&quot;args&quot;:[&quot;=R0VU&quot;],&quot;match&quot;:&quot;0&quot;,&quot;encodeflag&quot;:true}].</p>
<p>Supported key types: URL, Method, Post, Referer, Cookie, User-Agent, CustomHeader, IPLocation, CaptchaRisk, CaptchaDeviceRisk, CaptchaScore.</p>
<p>Match operators by key type:</p>
<ul>
<li>When Key is URL: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 1 (prefix), 6 (suffix), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains)</li>
<li>When Key is Method: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal)</li>
<li>When Key is Post: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains)</li>
<li>When Key is Cookie: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains)</li>
<li>When Key is Referer: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 1 (prefix), 6 (suffix), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists), 4 (empty)</li>
<li>When Key is User-Agent: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 1 (prefix), 6 (suffix), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists), 4 (empty)</li>
<li>When Key is CustomHeader: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains), 4 (empty), 5 (not exists)</li>
<li>When Key is IPLocation: 13 (belongs to), 14 (not belongs to)</li>
<li>When Key is CaptchaRisk: 15 (numerically equal), 16 (numerically not equal), 13 (belongs to), 14 (not belongs to), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists)</li>
<li>When Key is CaptchaDeviceRisk: 13 (belongs to), 14 (not belongs to), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists)</li>
<li>When Key is CaptchaScore: 15 (numerically equal), 17 (numerically greater than), 18 (numerically less than), 19 (numerically greater than or equal), 20 (numerically less than or equal), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists)</li>
</ul>
<p>Encoding rules: The args parameter requires encodeflag to be set to true. For Post, Cookie, or CustomHeader keys, Base64 encode both parameter name and value (remove trailing =), then concatenate with = sign (e.g., Base64(name)=Base64(value)). For Referer or User-Agent keys, Base64 encode the value (remove trailing =) and prefix with = sign (e.g., =Base64(value)).</p>
</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">

</span>

        <span class="property-type">Number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Match method, 0(equal), 1(prefix), 2(contains), 3(not equal), 6(suffix), 7(not contains).</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_name_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_name_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>

        <span id="state_optionsarr_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_optionsarr_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">options<wbr>Arr</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd><p>CC matching conditions JSON serialized string. Example: [{&quot;key&quot;:&quot;Method&quot;,&quot;args&quot;:[&quot;=R0VU&quot;],&quot;match&quot;:&quot;0&quot;,&quot;encodeflag&quot;:true}].</p>
<p>Supported key types: URL, Method, Post, Referer, Cookie, User-Agent, CustomHeader, IPLocation, CaptchaRisk, CaptchaDeviceRisk, CaptchaScore.</p>
<p>Match operators by key type:</p>
<ul>
<li>When Key is URL: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 1 (prefix), 6 (suffix), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains)</li>
<li>When Key is Method: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal)</li>
<li>When Key is Post: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains)</li>
<li>When Key is Cookie: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains)</li>
<li>When Key is Referer: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 1 (prefix), 6 (suffix), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists), 4 (empty)</li>
<li>When Key is User-Agent: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 1 (prefix), 6 (suffix), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists), 4 (empty)</li>
<li>When Key is CustomHeader: 0 (equal), 3 (not equal), 2 (contains), 7 (not contains), 4 (empty), 5 (not exists)</li>
<li>When Key is IPLocation: 13 (belongs to), 14 (not belongs to)</li>
<li>When Key is CaptchaRisk: 15 (numerically equal), 16 (numerically not equal), 13 (belongs to), 14 (not belongs to), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists)</li>
<li>When Key is CaptchaDeviceRisk: 13 (belongs to), 14 (not belongs to), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists)</li>
<li>When Key is CaptchaScore: 15 (numerically equal), 17 (numerically greater than), 18 (numerically less than), 19 (numerically greater than or equal), 20 (numerically less than or equal), 12 (exists), 5 (not exists)</li>
</ul>
<p>Encoding rules: The args parameter requires encodeflag to be set to true. For Post, Cookie, or CustomHeader keys, Base64 encode both parameter name and value (remove trailing =), then concatenate with = sign (e.g., Base64(name)=Base64(value)). For Referer or User-Agent keys, Base64 encode the value (remove trailing =) and prefix with = sign (e.g., =Base64(value)).</p>
</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
